name: group-claims-management
description: Single-user local-first group claims management desktop application.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,electron-build,electron "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev:build --workspace electron" "npm run dev:start --workspace electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace electron
